title: Vegan Eggplant Kheer Curry
description: A rich and creamy Indian-inspired curry made with eggplant and kheer, perfect for a vegan dinner option.

ingredients.name: Kheer
ingredients.amount: 1 cup non-dairy kheer (such as almond or soy milk)

ingredients.name: Umami
ingredients.amount: 2 tablespoons umami seasoning (such as mushroom or soy sauce)

instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the eggplant and cook until it starts to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the turmeric, cumin, and garam masala, and stir to combine.
Add the kheer and umami seasoning, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes, or until the eggplant is tender.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve over rice or with naan bread.
